lines: Here's how to use E A Ledger Drill, in about two minutes.

label: Step 1 · Add it to your Home Screen
lines: First, the most important step. Add the app to your Home Screen before you study.
Your progress is saved on your phone, not in an account.
Safari can erase a website's saved data after a week without a visit. A Home Screen app keeps its own storage, so your progress stays put.

label: iPhone · Safari
lines: On iPhone, open the app in Safari.
Tap Share. On iOS 26, it's under the three-dot button.
Scroll down, and tap Add to Home Screen.
Leave Open as Web App switched on, and tap Add.

label: Android · Chrome
lines: On Android, open it in Chrome. Tap the three-dot menu, then Add to Home screen, or Install app.

label: Always open it from the icon
lines: From then on, always open it from the E A Drill icon.
Safari and the Home Screen app keep separate progress.
Already studied in Safari? Save a backup file there, then load it in the app.

label: Your tax city
lines: Up top, your study buddy says hello. Tap Play on his calculator to jump straight into a drill.
This is your tax city. The big number is how ready you are for this part.
Below it are your streak, reviews due, and today's goal. Switch parts here.

label: Towers are exam areas
lines: Each tower is one exam area. Floors fill in as you master it, and cabs on the avenue are reviews waiting for you.
Tap a tower to see its numbers, and drill just that area.

label: Times Square and 3D
lines: Times Square takes you down the canyon, and 3D opens the whole city full screen.

label: Play: the drill
lines: Tap Play to drill. Pick an answer, and you'll see right away if you got it, with an explanation and the I R S source.

label: Spaced review
lines: Miss one, and it comes back in five minutes. Get it right, and it waits longer each time, from a day up to five weeks.

label: Flag a question
lines: If a question looks wrong, flag it, and leave a note.

label: Exam sim
lines: Exam sim has the real test's shape: a hundred questions, three and a half hours, in three sections.
Once you leave a section, you can't go back. The break between sections stops the clock.

label: Your results
lines: At the end, you see your score by area, and every question you missed.

label: Menu: goal, reminder, backup
lines: Open the menu to set a daily goal, add a daily reminder to your calendar, and save a backup file every week or so.
One more time: add it to your Home Screen, and always open it from there. Now go build your city.
